about_the_game: Goblin Hunter is a retro dark fantasy action game where you tactically hunt goblins within their lairs using light, shadow, sound, and environmental traps. Forge bonds with scarred townsfolk by completing quests, build and upgrade your village to fend off invading goblin hordes, and overcome the protagonist's trauma and inner demons through your actions and choices.

content_descriptors.notes:
Combat Violence
Intense battles against fantasy creatures (e.g., goblins)
Basic blood effects during weapon attacks
Non-realistic corpse remnants after enemy defeat
Excluded Content
No sexual content or implications
No sexual violence, drugs, or self-harm themes
No real-world religious/racial references
